description: Interprets BCBS 239 (Basel Committee principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting) and identifies the Critical Data Elements and data quality monitoring a bank should govern. Input is the regulation text as the message; output is a markdown analysis with paragraph-level citations, criticality ratings, and catalog search terms. Interpretation only — it reads nothing from the catalog, creates nothing, and its output is a proposal for human review.

message.description: Text of BCBS 239, normally the bank-facing principles 1-11 from artifacts/bcbs239/bank_principles.txt. Send them together, not one principle at a time — CDEs are cross-cutting.
